headline.text: L3 ML1 down *over 40 minutes* for temper adjustments with no resolution by window close — 8 readings at -0.8.

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 2 Kitchen butter pump was reset and cleared within an hour. Jar shortage flagged at 07:15 — short 40,987 units (need 82,368, have 41,381) for today and tomorrow production.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML2 lost 30 minutes to a roller replacement on the flow-wrap twin vacuum belt but came back up before 07:00. ML3 waiting on tri clamp to complete pump swap.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML1 down since 06:34 for temper adjustments with 8 readings at -0.8 and no clear resolution by 07:15. MF Matrix flagged weight issues with maintenance making adjustments. ML4 short correct blocking bars on depositor 4 and missing saved centerlines for HER King Size flow-wrap.

notes.text: Alan Todd noted ML3 schedule for Aug 10 is missing the 2-hour chocolate-only dial-in window (06:00-08:00) that was agreed on weeks prior.

resolved.title: Sollich 2 Kitchen butter pump not working
resolved.summary: Butter pump failed and required mechanic reset before kitchen could proceed.
resolved.resolution: Reset completed at 05:57 — "The Sollinch 2 Kitchen butter pump was reseted and is now working properly" (S4 Kitchen Tablet).

resolved.title: ML2 roller failure on flow-wrap twin vacuum belt
resolved.summary: Line stopped at 06:08 to replace roller on the twin vacuum belt inside the flow-wrap, down approximately 30 minutes.
resolved.resolution: Line restarted at 06:57 — "Line start running up" (ML2 FW). Down time confirmed at 30 minutes.

resolved.title: Zone pressure gauge valve on red
resolved.summary: Gauge valve hit red on ML1, maintenance responded and brought it back to green within 2 minutes.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 05:59 — "Back in the green now" (Nathan Ruiz).

needs_attention.title: Jar shortage for SKU 40105-V3
needs_attention.summary: Production needs 82,368 jars for today and tomorrow but only 41,381 are available — short 40,987 units.
needs_attention.status: Flagged at 07:15 with high importance, no response in window.

needs_attention.title: ML3 pump replacement waiting on tri clamp
needs_attention.summary: L1 sent replacement pump but install is blocked waiting on tri clamp fitting; Alex checking L1 for spare.
needs_attention.status: Pump received from L1 at 06:54 but missing tri clamp; Alex went to L1 to search for one, no confirmation of install completion.

needs_attention.title: ML1 down for temper adjustments
needs_attention.summary: Line stopped at 06:34 with 8 temper readings at -0.8; multiple water temperature adjustments requested but no confirmation line is back up.
needs_attention.status: Down since 06:34, operator making adjustments per Shawn Jewkes guidance (water jacket to 89, mixing water to 84, cold water to 58). No resolution by 07:15 window close.

needs_attention.title: MF Matrix weight issues
needs_attention.summary: Line flagged weight variances; maintenance notified and making adjustments on the production line.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance on line making adjustments as of 06:40, no confirmation weights are back in spec.

needs_attention.title: Wrong blocking bars on ML4 depositor 4
needs_attention.summary: Blocking bars currently on depositor 4 are incorrect; Victor searching for the correct ones.
needs_attention.status: Victor looking for correct blocking bars as of 06:38, no update on whether they were located.

needs_attention.title: Missing centerlines for HER King Size flow-wrap
needs_attention.summary: ML4 has no saved centerlines for HER King Size FW in system, only snack size; operators need settings to run product.
needs_attention.status: Flagged to Shawn Jewkes at 06:50; Shawn responding he'll check when he arrives but names look different than expected.
